page.overview:
Who is Ovelia Atkascha?

Ovelia Atkascha is a guest and a major character in Final Fantasy Tactics. She is a princess of Ivalice who was the adopted daughter of the late King Ondoria III after he lost his second son. Ovelia was entrusted to Duke Larg.

Due to her royal status, she becomes involved in various schemes of the nobility, who wish to gain the throne of Ivalice. Protected by Agrias Oaks and the Lionsguard, Ovelia is kidnapped by Delita Heiral in the events that lead up to the War of the Lions.

Ovelia's job is the princess, allowing her to cast Holy Magicks to protect herself from harm.

Ovelia was believed to be born the daughter of King Denamda IV and is the half-sister of King Ondoria III by different mothers. In reality, the trueborn daughter to King Denamda IV had died as a baby, with Ovelia raised as a replacement in her stead, in a secret plot concocted by the Council as a means to thwart any claims of succession from Queen Louveria Atkascha. which Delita backed up, the Personae under Chronicles did not confirm this. However, Persons in The Ivalice Chronicles confirmed this to be the case.}}
